zh-CN.title: 官方通知体验修复
items: 官方通知现在会正确显示轻量底色、细边框和强调装饰
从通知查看投稿时会自动进入我的投稿并打开对应会话

en.title: Official notice fixes
items: Official notices now correctly show their subtle surface, border, and accent treatment
Opening a submission notice now switches to My submissions and opens the matching conversation
